prompt:
Normalize the one contact block in the user's note. Output only a bare JSON object with exactly name, phone, email, company, country; each value is a string or null.

Read only the record's label/value lines (varying labels, colon/equals/tab separators, any order), not notes or signatures. Trim and collapse whitespace to single spaces. Absent, empty or whole-value placeholders (-, --, n/a, na, none, unknown, ?, null, TBD; case-insensitive) are missing and become null, except for country inference below. Never derive values from surrounding text, domains or company suffixes.

Select email by @ and phone by content regardless of labels: after removing leading tel: and a trailing extension (ext. N, ext N, xN, #N, extension N), a phone has at least seven digits and only digits, spaces and + - ( ) . /. Use the country line for country. Use the name and company lines for those fields, swapping them first if only the name-line value ends in a listed legal suffix.

- Email: remove mailto: and enclosing angle brackets, then lowercase the source address exactly; do not reconstruct or change its spelling or accents.
- Name: reorder Last, First at the first comma; strip leading Dr, Mr, Mrs, Ms, Mx, Prof (optional dot, any case). Capitalize the first character and lowercase the rest of each space- or hyphen-separated part. Preserve Unicode letters and diacritics; do not transliterate.
- Company: strip a case-insensitive trailing suffix and optional preceding comma: AB, GmbH, AG, Ltd, Ltd., PLC, Inc, Inc., LLC, Corp, Corp., AS, ASA, Oy, Oyj, A/S, ApS, SA, SAS, B.V., N.V., S.p.A., Sp. z o.o., K.K., Pty Ltd, Ltda. Uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest of each space-separated word.
- Country: map English, Swedish or German names and alpha-2/alpha-3 codes in any case to uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Aliases: UK/Great Britain → GB, Holland → NL, USA/U.S.A. → US, Türkiye → TR, Czech Republic → CZ.
- Phone: output E.164 (+ and digits only). With tel: and extension stripped, ignore an opening parenthesis when testing for + or 00. International: replace 00 with +, remove (0) and all spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and parentheses; keep the written calling code. Only if country is missing, infer country from a uniquely assigned calling code; shared codes like +1 and +7 give null. On disagreement keep both the line's country and the phone's own code. National: strip separators, remove one leading trunk 0 and prepend + and the normalized record country's calling code; without a country, return null.
